## Solución
<div class="twocol">

<div class="card fragment fade-up crispdm-card--gray" data-fragment-index="1">
<h4 class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="2" style="font-size: 28px;">Espacio muestral completo $\Omega$</h4>
<div class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="3" style="font-size: 19px;">
<p>$\Omega = \{$VVVV, VVVN, VVNV, VVNN,</p>
<p style="padding-left: 28px;">VNVV, VNVN, VNNV, VNNN,</p>
<p style="padding-left: 28px;">NVVV, NVVN, NVNV, NVNN,</p>
<p style="padding-left: 28px;">NNVV, NNVN, NNNV, NNNN$\}$</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="card fragment fade-up crispdm-card--gray" data-fragment-index="4">
<h4 class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="5" style="font-size: 28px;">Eventos</h4>
<ul>
<li class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="6" style="font-size: 22px;">
<strong>$A$ (exactamente 2 viables):</strong>
$$A = \{\text{VVNN, VNVN, VNNV, NVVN, NVNV, NNVV}\}$$
$|A| = \binom{4}{2} = 6$
</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="7" style="font-size: 22px;">
<strong>$B$ (al menos 3 viables):</strong>
$$B = \{\text{VVVN, VVNV, VNVV, NVVV, VVVV}\}$$
$|B| = \binom{4}{3} + \binom{4}{4} = 4 + 1 = 5$
</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="8" style="font-size: 22px; text-align: justify;">
$A \cap B = \emptyset$ ya que no es posible tener exactamente 2 viables y al menos 3 viables al mismo tiempo.
</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>
